raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

#37577 added watermark-secret redaction to request logging even when `--enable-watermark` is absent. The redactor recursively copies token lists before the formatter applies its field exclusions, so long prompts consume tokenizer-process CPU even at log level 1, where token IDs are not printed.

## Modifications

Gate the text and JSON request-log redaction calls on `get_exec().features.enable_watermark`. When disabled, return the data unchanged without importing or calling the watermark redactor. When enabled, keep the existing redaction behavior.

Document that request-log watermark redaction follows the server flag. This applies to native Receive/Finish logs and raw OpenAI request logs, including client-supplied watermark fields.

Related: #44692 optimizes redaction when it runs; this change skips it when watermarking is disabled.

## Accuracy Tests

Logging-only change; no inference accuracy run needed.

`PYTHONPATH=python python test/registered/unit/utils/test_request_logger.py`: **2 tests passed**. The tests cover text and JSON logs, default-disabled logging with token lists that fail if traversed, and enabled/disabled redaction for native and raw OpenAI request logs. Both tests fail on the pre-fix main (`b588aa39e9`); the enabled-redaction cases already pass there.

Changed-file pre-commit checks passed.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Local CPU formatter benchmark using the real `GenerateReqInput` and request-log formatter: 124,000 input IDs, log level 1, watermarking disabled, one Receive + Finish pair, minimum of seven repetitions on each tree.

| Tree | Formatting time |
| --- | ---: |
| Main (`b588aa39e9`) | 91.339 ms |
| This PR | 0.079 ms |

This measures formatter cost only; no end-to-end serving benchmark was run.

## Checklist

- [x] Changed-file pre-commit checks pass.
- [x] Added CPU regression tests and verified failure before the fix.
- [x] Updated watermark logging documentation.
- [x] Provided a formatter benchmark; inference accuracy is unaffected.
- [x] Read the resolved flag through the runtime configuration namespace.

+Use a regular config file readable only by the server account for keys; inline JSON is visible in the process command line. Launch-command, server-info, and crash-payload rendering redacts key fields and the `--watermark-config` value. Request logs redact watermark keys only when `--enable-watermark` is set. Process command lines, client request bodies, and process or GPU core dumps remain separate secret-bearing surfaces.
 
 ## Per-request control

@@ -0,0 +1,71 @@
+"""Request logging must not traverse hidden token lists when watermarking is off."""
+
+import dataclasses
+import unittest
+
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_context
+from sglang.srt.utils.request_logger import RequestLogger
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class _UnreadableList(list):
+    def __iter__(self):
+        raise AssertionError("logging traversed a skipped token list")
+
+
+@dataclasses.dataclass
+class _Request:
+    rid: str
+    input_ids: list
+    sampling_params: dict
+
+
+class TestRequestLogger(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_disabled_watermark_does_not_read_hidden_tokens(self):
+        """Level-1 Receive/Finish logs must leave skipped token payloads untouched."""
+        req = _Request("r1", _UnreadableList([1, 2, 3]), {"temperature": 0.7})
+        out = {"output_ids": _UnreadableList([4]), "meta_info": {"id": "r1"}}
+        with get_context().override_server_args():
+            for log_format in ("text", "json"):
+                with self.subTest(log_format=log_format):
+                    logger = RequestLogger(True, 1, log_format, None)
+                    with self.assertLogs(logger.targets[0], level="INFO") as logs:
+                        logger.log_received_request(req)
+                        logger.log_finished_request(req, out)
+                    self.assertEqual(len(logs.records), 2)
+                    for record in logs.records:
+                        self.assertIn("r1", record.getMessage())
+                        self.assertNotIn("input_ids", record.getMessage())
+                        self.assertNotIn("output_ids", record.getMessage())
+
+    def test_watermark_redaction_follows_server_flag(self):
+        """The flag controls redaction for native and raw OpenAI request logs."""
+        params = {"watermark": {"key": "0123456789abcdef", "enabled": True}}
+        req = _Request("r1", [1, 2, 3], params)
+        out = {"meta_info": {"id": "r1"}}
+        for enabled in (False, True):
+            with get_context().override_server_args(enable_watermark=enabled):
+                for log_format in ("text", "json"):
+                    with self.subTest(enabled=enabled, log_format=log_format):
+                        logger = RequestLogger(True, 1, log_format, None)
+                        with self.assertLogs(logger.targets[0], level="INFO") as logs:
+                            logger.log_received_request(req)
+                            logger.log_finished_request(req, out)
+                            logger.log_openai_received_request(params)
+                        self.assertEqual(len(logs.records), 3)
+                        for record in logs.records:
+                            message = record.getMessage()
+                            if enabled:
+                                self.assertIn("<redacted>", message)
+                                self.assertNotIn("0123456789abcdef", message)
+                            else:
+                                self.assertIn("0123456789abcdef", message)
+                                self.assertNotIn("<redacted>", message)
+        self.assertEqual(params["watermark"]["key"], "0123456789abcdef")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
